image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a young girl with long brown hair. She is holding her right index finger up towards the camera, displaying a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) wrapped around the fingertip. The bandage has a visible central pad and perforated texture. There is also a smaller, transparent or silver decorative strip/bandage on her forehead. The image has a vintage/filtered aesthetic with vignetting.

The shape matches the standard Band-Aid geometry perfectly.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking fine pores or natural imperfections, likely due to heavy filtering or AI generation smoothing.
The index finger holding the bandage appears slightly elongated and the knuckle joints are somewhat indistinct, suggesting minor structural warping common in AI hands.
The object on the forehead is ambiguous—it looks like a decorative sticker or a second bandage, but its edges blend slightly into the skin/hairline, lacking crisp definition.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a medical adhesive bandage and not a similar-looking prop or artifact.
To audit the structural integrity of the fingers and hand, which are high-risk areas for AI generation errors (extra joints, melting).
To check for edge bleeding between the bandage and the skin, ensuring the object is topologically distinct.
To assess the severity of the skin smoothing and filter artifacts noted in the initial scan.

focus_areas: Finger anatomy and joint structure under the bandage
Edge sharpness of the bandage against the skin
Texture consistency of the bandage backing (perforations)
Naturalness of skin texture vs. AI smoothing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the finger holding the bandage. AI often struggles with fingers wrapping around objects. Verify if the bandage logically occludes the finger and if the finger anatomy behind/around the bandage is plausible. Also, distinguish between artistic filtering (vintage look) and generative artifacts (melting/smearing).
